headline: Rollins avenge home defeat at Embry-Riddle
dek: Beaten at home by Embry-Riddle before conference play opened, Rollins won the return and ended their hosts' unbeaten season. Rollins have now won four matches, drawn one and lost two, and have not conceded a goal since losing at Tampa.
displaced_by: Rollins won at Embry-Riddle, the last unbeaten side; Florida Southern no longer share the top of the table and have conceded seven, not six

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and neither of those sides has yet taken a point in conference play.

wire.line: Rollins have ended Embry-Riddle's unbeaten run, and no side in the conference is now without a defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no result: Palm Beach Atlantic's against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's at home to Trinity.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Embry-Riddle's defeat at home to Rollins was their first of the season, after five wins and two draws.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic have conceded six goals across three wins, three draws and two defeats.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Florida Tech have won four, drawn three and lost one, and have not lost since their opening match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ricardo Marques has kept four shutouts for Florida Southern.

last_match.line: Embry-Riddle had won the earlier meeting at Rollins and had not lost all season; Rollins have kept out every opponent since losing at Tampa.

next_match.line: Tampa are unbeaten since August; Barry have yet to win at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
